summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to allow businesses to receive the same tax deductions for donating food transportation vehicles and food storage equipment to non-profit organizations that provide food to communities in need as they currently do for donating food inventory.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to expand tax deductions for charitable donations of food transportation vehicles and food storage/preparation equipment. This effectively lowers the tax burden for businesses making such donations, thus reducing tax revenue.
